forum.title: Complementary timer channels are not working in STM8S105.
forum.best_answer_content:
Complementary channels are only available if enabled in Option Bytes OPT2 AFR5. See STM8S105x4/6 datasheet page 49.

AFR5 Alternate function remapping option 5

0: AFR5 remapping option inactive: Default alternate function.(2)

1: Port B3 alternate function = TIM1\_ETR; port B2 alternate function = TIM1\_CH3N; port B1 alternate function = TIM1\_CH2N; port B0 alternate function = TIM1\_CH1N.

Did you enable them in Option Bytes?
forum.author: ankhola
